iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: US-Iran 2-week ceasefire reached Apr 7-8. Trump pulled back from bombing civilian infrastructure. Talks to begin Islamabad Apr 11. Ceasefire FRAGILE — Israel reports incoming Iranian missile barrage despite announcement. IAEA unable to verify Iran halted enrichment. 440.9kg 60%-enriched uranium stockpile — location partially unknown. Bushehr nuclear plant struck. UN Security Council Resolution 2817 condemned Iran. Iran 10-point plan grants it Strait of Hormuz dominance under 'regulated passage'.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Active war paused by 2-week ceasefire Apr 7-8. 900+ US-Israel strikes Feb 28-Mar. Iran struck US bases across Gulf. Strait of Hormuz under 'regulated passage' per Iran's 10-point plan. Hezbollah engaged. UAE missile alert triggered Apr 7 despite ceasefire. Pakistan mediated US-Iran talks. Ceasefire very fragile — both sides reserve rights.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: CEASEFIRE DOES NOT INCLUDE LEBANON. IDF 98th Commando Division expanded ground ops in southern Lebanon. Netanyahu confirmed US-Iran ceasefire excludes Lebanon. Hezbollah continued attacks Mar 3-Apr 6. Israel expanding buffer zone. Separate active conflict from Iran war.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: FM Fidan Feb 9 suggested Turkey would acquire nuclear weapons if Iran does. Playing strategic ambiguity. NATO expanding footprint. OSW analysis: shift in transatlantic relations could trigger nuclear pursuit. No new developments in 24h.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: CFR report: Kashmir trigger risk for armed conflict 2026. Mini-war May 2025. Both boosting weapons. US intel warns nuclear conflict possible. Pakistan mediated US-Iran talks — constructive diplomatic role. No new escalation in 24h.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: New START expired Feb 4 2026. Putin warned US-Israel on Iran nuclear. 'Easter escalation' — massive air strikes on Ukraine Apr 3. Russia supplying Iran cyber support + targeting data for Houthi strikes on shipping (Reuters Apr 7). Lavrov: no nuclear use 'at this stage.' Nuclear doctrine allows use against large-scale conventional attacks. Standing with Iran diplomatically.

china.name: China
china.notes: US intel does NOT expect Taiwan invasion 2027. ISW Apr 3 update: no significant PLA activity changes. Hosting Pakistan-Afghanistan peace talks. PLA Navy preparing new Type 09V SSGN. No material change in 24h.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: DPRK declared nuclear status 'irreversible' Apr 7. Multiple ballistic missiles Apr 7 (second event in 2 days). CSIS event Apr 8 on nuclear submarine program. UPI: maintenance on 'Hero Kim Gun Ok' submarine COMPLETE — test launches imminent. Kim visited nuclear submarine factory. New naval destroyer with strategic cruise missiles tested.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4. 'Easter escalation' — Russia unleashing massive air strikes on Ukraine Apr 3+. GCRI: nuclear risk if Russia fails. Russia targeting Ukrainian refineries with drones Apr 6. No negotiated settlement. Hybrid warfare intensifying. Russia coordinating with Iran on cyber/Houthi operations.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan declared 'open war' Feb 27. Hundreds killed. Now: peace talks in Beijing, mediated by China. Ceasefire reported successful Apr 7 (ARY News). Pakistani officials helped mediate US-Iran ceasefire. Diplomatic track active — trend toward de-escalation.
